definitions.explanation: A direct, coarse word for urine or urinating. Common in everyday male speech and informal writing, but considered crude in polite contexts.

definitions.gloss: backing out; reneging on a deal (slang)
definitions.explanation: Used in expressions like {小便|しょうべん}する to mean breaking a promise, walking away from a deal, or pulling out of an arrangement. Rough, informal register.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{電柱|でんちゅう}→電柱：17913_denchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{小便|しょうべん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The dog peed on the utility pole.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小便|しょうべん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{酔|よ}っ{払|ぱら}い→酔っ払い：09429_yopparai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{道端|みちばた}→道端：28126_michibata⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{小便|しょうべん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{眉|まゆ}→眉：04267_mayu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ひそめた→ひそめる：28429_hisomeru⟧。
examples.english: I frowned when I saw a drunk man urinating on the side of the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{土|ど}{壇場|たんば}→土壇場：10555_dotanba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{小便|しょうべん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He backed out at the last minute.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{小便|しょうべん}⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大|おお}{損|ぞん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The company took a huge loss when the other side reneged on an important contract.

examples.japanese: {口|くち}{約束|やくそく}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{小便|しょうべん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧してきた。
examples.english: I've experienced people backing out on verbal-only promises many times.

notes:
Literally "small convenience," paired with ⟦{大便|だいべん}→大便：24207_daiben⟧ ("large convenience," feces). In polite or medical contexts, use {尿|にょう} or ⟦おしっこ→おしっこ：09083_oshikko⟧ instead. {小便|しょうべん} sounds rough and is more common in male speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小便|しょうべん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to urinate
- ⟦{立|た}ち→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧{小便|しょうべん}: urinating in public (a punishable minor offense)
- {小便|しょうべん}⟦{小僧|こぞう}→小僧：12388_kozou⟧: "the peeing boy" — a famous statue, also a metaphor for someone immature

REGISTER:
- ⟦おしっこ→おしっこ：09083_oshikko⟧: pee — childish/cute, used by children or with children
- {尿|にょう}: urine — clinical/medical
- {小用|しょうよう}: number one — softer, often used in older or polite speech
- {小便|しょうべん}: pee, piss — rough, masculine register

SENSE 2 NOTE:
"To back out" usage is slangy and rare in polite contexts; common in business gossip and rough speech.
